title: Head – Credit & Risk
cardBlurb: Build the credit engine of an AI-native NBFC in the making, from the first policy to launch day.
description:
Pfundit Capital Private Ltd., a subsidiary of Pfundit Pte. Ltd., Singapore, is building a technology-first lending company for India and is preparing to apply to the Reserve Bank of India for registration as a Non-Banking Financial Company. We’re looking for our first senior credit leader. You will own credit risk end to end, write the credit policy and risk framework for a planned portfolio of consumer loans, loans against property (LAP) and MSME loans, and work with our technology and data teams to turn sound credit judgement into a data-driven decision engine. If you want to build credit and risk the right way, with clean policy, disciplined underwriting and data at the core, from blueprint to launch, this is your seat.

What You Will Do

  • Write the credit policy, risk appetite and product credit norms from day zero, in line with RBI requirements for NBFCs.
  • Set underwriting standards for consumer, LAP and MSME lending, from borrower and cash-flow assessment to property valuation, legal title and collateral.
  • Turn credit judgement into decision rules, scorecards and workflows with engineering and data teams, and define where a credit officer stays in the loop.
  • Own portfolio credit risk: set risk and concentration limits, and design the monitoring, earlywarning, stress-testing, collections and expected-credit-loss provisioning frameworks.
  • Once we are registered and operational, lead underwriting and credit risk for the early book, report on portfolio risk to management and the Board, and build the credit team.

Who You Are

8–12 years in credit at an NBFC, HFC, bank or fintech lender, including at least 3 years as deputy to a head of credit or risk, or leading a regional or product credit team. Deep, hands-on experience in consumer and MSME lending, especially unsecured consumer loans underwritten on alternative income data, LAP and secured business loans, and a sound grasp of the risks in invoice, purchase and dealer financing and revenue-based financing (loans repaid from future business revenues). You have helped write and run credit policy, assessed businesses using GST, banking and bureau data, and tracked portfolio quality, and you know RBI regulation for NBFCs. You are ready to step up to head the function. You can say “no” with data and “yes” with conviction.

Application & Contact

Apply directly using the application form on this page, or send your CV and portfolio to careers@pfundit.com with the subject line “Head – Credit & Risk”.

title: Head – Business Development, Sales & Partnerships
cardBlurb: Build the growth engine of an AI-native NBFC in the making: its channels, its partners and its market.
description:
Pfundit Capital Private Ltd., a subsidiary of Pfundit Pte. Ltd., Singapore, is building a technology-first lending company for India and is preparing to apply to the Reserve Bank of India for registration as a Non-Banking Financial Company. We’re looking for our first senior growth leader. You will design how we reach customers and scale: a hub-and-spoke distribution model combining our own on-ground sales and origination teams with channel partners and digital journeys for a planned portfolio of consumer loans, loans against property (LAP) and MSME loans, with compliance and credit discipline built in from the start. If you want to take a lender’s distribution from blueprint to a national footprint, the right way, this is your seat.

What You Will Do

  • Shape go-to-market across consumer loans, LAP and MSME lending: segments, hub and spoke locations, in-house and partner channel mix, and acquisition economics.
  • Design the channel-partner framework, covering selection, due diligence, onboarding and governance of DSAs, connectors and advisers, in line with RBI outsourcing and digital lending norms.
  • Build strategic, API-led and embedded-finance partnerships with platforms, ecosystems, anchors and dealer networks that serve consumers and MSMEs.
  • Design the hub-and-spoke sales operating model: structure, roles and productivity norms for our in-house sales and origination teams, with incentives and commissions that reward quality of book, not just volume.
  • Once we are registered and operational, lead origination and partner activation for the early book, and build the in-house sales, origination and partnerships teams across our hubs and spokes.

Who You Are

10–15+ years in business development, sales or partnerships at an NBFC, HFC, bank or fintech lender, including 4–5 years in leadership. You have built and led on-ground sales and origination teams across branches alongside DSA and partner channels, scaling consumer and MSME lending, especially unsecured consumer loans underwritten on alternative income data, LAP and secured business loans. Experience with anchor, distributor or dealer-led invoice, purchase and dealer financing, or revenuebased financing, is valuable. You know RBI’s digital lending, outsourcing and fair-practices rules for NBFCs and how they apply to our field teams, DSAs and partners. You grow a business by building trust, and you protect it by refusing shortcuts.

Application & Contact

Apply directly using the application form on this page, or send your CV and portfolio to careers@pfundit.com with the subject line “Head – Business Development, Sales & Partnerships”.

title: Technology Lead – NBFC Digital Lending Platform
cardBlurb: Build the technology backbone of an AI-native NBFC in the making, from the first integration to launch and beyond.
description:
Pfundit Capital Private Ltd., a subsidiary of Pfundit Pte. Ltd., Singapore, is building a technology-first lending company for India and is preparing to apply to the Reserve Bank of India for registration as a Non-Banking Financial Company. We’re looking for the engineer who will own its lending platform and technology for the long term. You will help architect and integrate an API-first digital lending stack, bringing together a configurable LOS/LMS and specialist partners for KYC, credit bureau, Account Aggregator, eSign, payments and collections, on cloud, code and data owned by Pfundit. You will initially be employed by our managed technology-services partner and work full-time on Pfundit, with the intention of transferring to Pfundit Capital Private Ltd. as Technology Lead after it receives RBI registration and is ready to make direct hires. If you would rather build a regulated lending platform from the ground up than inherit a mature one, this is your seat.

What You Will Do

  • Work with our solution architect on architecture and design across the stack, from cloud, data and APIs to backend and front end, translating lending, risk and compliance requirements into clear specifications and pragmatic buy-versus-build decisions.
  • Lead the cross-functional engineering team (backend, front end, UI/UX, data and DevOps) and third-party providers: set priorities, run sprints, releases and end-to-end testing of the borrower journey, and stay hands-on through code and design reviews.
  • Own the engineering foundations: AWS cloud infrastructure, DevOps and CI/CD, code quality, and a fast, intuitive experience for borrowers and partners.
  • Build in security, privacy and auditability from day one, in line with RBI’s IT, cyber-security and digital lending expectations, including India data residency, least-privilege access, audit logs and VAPT readiness.
  • Prepare the platform for AI and agentic workflows, working with our AI team on data contracts, APIs and workflow events.
  • After transfer, own the technology roadmap, vendor governance and production operations, and build the in-house team.

Who You Are

7–10 years in backend or full-stack engineering, solution architecture or platform operations, including 3–5 years building technology for lending, payments or other financial services at an NBFC, bank or fintech, or at a technology or services firm serving them. You understand a modern lender’s stack end to end, from cloud infrastructure (AWS preferred), data and APIs to backend services, front end, UI/UX, DevOps and CI/CD, and you still enjoy writing code. You have led cross-functional engineering teams across these disciplines, and you know how to hire, mentor and grow engineers and hold a high bar for quality and delivery, including with vendor and partner teams. Familiarity with India’s digital lending rails is a strong plus, and you are pragmatic about buy-versus-build.

Application & Contact

Apply directly using the application form on this page, or send your CV and portfolio to careers@pfundit.com with the subject line “Technology Lead – NBFC Digital Lending Platform”.
